findings.title: Design-time safety test asserts output substrings only
findings.description: C8-M01 regression checks absence of forbidden destination strings in ef command output, not the configured connection/destination. Local repro showed fail-closed with uninitialized ConnectionString and empty server, so production path looks correct; the regression guard remains weaker than a positive destination assertion.
evidence: Local: dotnet-ef database update without ConnectionStrings__Database -> exit 1, 'ConnectionString property has not been initialized', database '' on server ''
findings.required_fix: Optionally assert positive fail-closed signals (uninitialized connection / empty server) or inspect design-time options destination.

findings.title: Timeout vs command-timeout exit classification race
findings.description: Migrator sets both Npgsql CommandTimeout and a 60s CTS. The lock-based test requires exact Timeout exit code 2, which can race with command-timeout classified as Failure 1, despite still being bounded and non-zero.
evidence: Test asserts ExitCode == MigratorExitCode.Timeout and Duration in [50s, 120s]
findings.required_fix: Optionally assert non-zero within budget, or separate CTS budget from command timeout to make Timeout classification deterministic.
